criteria.reasoning: The deliverables table shows D1 with "Year 1 target 120", "Result 131" and "Met".

The memo marks D2 as "Borderline — see note A" rather than not met, and calls it "borderline-not-met". It treats Marcus's reading as a live alternative ("under that more favorable reading 94 ≥ 90 and D2 is met") and asks the Foundation to decide. That leaves D2's status unsettled and entertains the 94-vs-90 comparison the criterion rejects.
D3 is reported as "61 of 94 = 64.9%" and "Met". The memo notes that Marcus's 83.6% uses a different denominator and that "the agreement-language number should be the one in the report."
D4 shows "26 (1 more tutor still in training, 8 hrs)" against a target of 25, marked "Met". It does not count 27 tutors as trained.

D5 is marked "Not yet met", with the July 16 meeting framed as able to satisfy Year 1. The calendar calls it the "Year 1 Q4 Employer Advisory Council meeting, rescheduled. Must be held for D5 to be reported as met", and the action list says "Without it, D5 cannot be reported as met." That counts the July 16, 2026 meeting toward Year 1 instead of reporting D5 as not met.

The memo does identify AP-2242 ($640 beer and wine) as unallowable under Section 6.3 and says to move it to unrestricted funds. But its variance table still counts the charge: "Tutor training (as charged) $5,340 +$340 +6.8%" and a total of "$119,306 ... −$694". The criterion fails a memo that counts the $640 anywhere in its totals or variances.
Learner supports is shown as $12,000 approved, $13,560 charged, "+$1,560", "+13.0%", with "Yes — not requested" for Foundation approval. The memo cites Section 5's prior-written-approval requirement.
Curriculum and materials is shown as $8,000 approved, $6,920 charged, "−$1,080", "−13.5%", flagged as needing approval. The text says "Same Section 5 approval applies" to the under-run.
Every other line shows "No" in the Foundation-approval column, including Tutor training ("No (but see unallowable note)") and Local travel ("No"). Only Learner supports and Curriculum are flagged.

Personnel (−$1,020, −1.5%), Fringe (−$204, −1.5%), Local travel (−$290, −8.06%) and Evaluation ($0) match. But the variance table gives Tutor training as "+$340 | +6.8%", the failing figure that counts the alcohol charge. The later text gives $4,700 (−6.0%), so the memo contradicts itself on this line.

The memo states "allowable Year 1 spending is $118,666 and $1,334 carries forward to Year 2", and Section 3 repeats both figures. The $119,306 is labelled only as charged to Fund 310, and $694 is never called the unspent amount.
The calendar shows "2026-08-14 (Fri) Interim report due — within 45 days after Year 1 end, per Section 7.1."
The calendar lists "2027-04-01 | Outside deadline to request a no-cost extension (90 days before grant end), per Section 8."

The memo gives "2027-09-28 | Final report due — within 90 days after grant end". It never says that unspent grant funds are returned with the final report, so it omits one of the two required elements.
